name: Hürtgenwald
type: municipality without town privileges in Germany
text: Hürtgenwald (German pronunciation: [ˈhʏʁtɡn̩ˌvalt]; Ripuarian: Hüêtschewald) is a municipality in the district of Düren in the federal state of North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany. It is located in the Eifel hills, approx. 15 km south-west of Düren.

depictions.name: Hurtgen
depictions.text: Hurtgen or Hürtgen may refer to: Battle of Hürtgen Forest - A historical WWII battle on which several levels in various Call of Duty games have been based Festung Recogne - A campaign level in Call of Duty that is referred to as "Hurtgen" Hurtgen (map) - A multiplayer map in Call of Duty based on the campaign level listed above Hurtgen (soundtrack) - A song in the Call of Duty: WWII (Official Soundtrack)
